relationships.subject: IL-4
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that intrathecal administration of IL-4 to SpNT mice enhanced the increase in CD11c+ cells in the SDH

relationships.subject: CD11c+ microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: indicating the necessity of spinal CD11c+ microglia for the pain-relieving effect of intrathecal IL-4

relationships.subject: IGF1
relationships.evidence_quote: IGF1 appears to be necessary for the pain-relieving effect of CD11c+ microglia induced by IL-4

key_findings: Intrathecal IL-4 increases CD11c+ SDH microglia, required for its analgesic effect in SpNT and SNI models.
CD11c+ microglia emergence and Igf1 expression are blunted in SNI vs SpNT.
